propositions: materialize_tickets writes a full 620 MiB copy of the ticket tree per gate resolution despite adjacent commits differing by single files, producing ~10^5x write amplification due to zero key reuse

the tickets cache key (resolved from live tracker HEAD) advances every ~26 seconds with no reuse, causing every resolution to miss the cache and append a new full entry rather than amortize across resolutions
hardlinking or reflink-based delta materialization against the prior entry can recover write efficiency while preserving immutability and attestation integrity
concurrent multi-agent gate resolution multiplies per-resolution I/O overhead directly, creating resource starvation and timeout symptoms under load

snapshot store byte accounting must distinguish between inclusive entry_size (for reporting shared usage), exclusive_size (incremental bytes on populate/evict), and distinct_bytes (ground truth for sweep), so free-space reclamation credits only bytes actually leaving disk
